svg.aria-label: Proxmox host pve.swagger.lab on a Dell PowerEdge R720: vmbr0 management 192.168.10.3, vmbr1 VM trunk for VLANs 20 and 40, 384 GB of memory. Virtual machines: SWAGGER-DC-01, Primary domain controller, AD DS, DNS, DHCP, NTP, Windows Server 2022, 192.168.40.1; SWAGGER-DC-02, Second domain controller, AD DS, DNS, Windows Server 2022, 192.168.40.2; SWAGGER-FS-01, File server and patching, File shares, WSUS, Windows Server 2022, 192.168.40.3; SWAGGER-CA-01, PKI and network policy, AD CS, NPS (RADIUS), Windows Server 2022, 192.168.40.4; SWAGGER-NMS-01, Docker host, monitoring and SIEM, Docker, Portainer, LibreNMS, Wazuh, Splunk, Linux, 192.168.40.5; SWAGGER-WKS-01, Domain-joined test client, Logons, Group Policy, Windows 11, DHCP.
